visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses sits at a table drinking from a white paper cup with a focused expression. The camera cuts to a young woman with short brown hair wearing a beige cutout top in a brightly lit indoor studio with shelves and chairs. She looks distressed, looking side-to-side before smiling and raising her index finger as if struck by a sudden idea. (2) A white graphic icon with the text 'ESC' and '逃跑神器' appears floating next to the woman's head as she holds a smartphone. The scene transitions to a top-down close-up of the smartphone screen where a finger interacts with a purple and blue interface, typing the words '老板' and '台灣' using a Chinese keyboard. (3) The phone screen suddenly displays a realistic incoming call interface labeled '老板' (Boss) from '台灣'. Cut back to the woman holding the phone; she waves her hand dismissively at the man and walks away towards the camera. (4) The woman is now in an office setting with computer monitors in the background, looking at her phone with a frustrated expression. She opens the app again, which features a grid of colorful tiles, and proceeds to type into a form to generate a fake message notification. (5) The phone screen shows a fake message notification on a simulated lock screen. The woman looks at the screen and smiles mischievously at the camera. A circular green graphic with the text '計畫通り' appears over her face to emphasize her success. (6) At a restaurant table, the woman sits with a man and another woman who are looking away. The main woman takes out her phone and taps a yellow tile in the app interface. The screen displays a '10% Battery' warning followed by a black screen with a red low-battery icon. (7) She shows the black screen to her companions with a fake concerned look while they appear skeptical. The final scene shows her in a kitchen area, looking sad with animated blue tears added to her face while standing near a large industrial water heater.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 天啊 這個約會對象太奇怪了吧. (2) [Slogan]: ESC 逃跑神器. (3) [Subtitle]: 啊 想到了 可以使用我昨天載的 逃跑神器. (4) [Subtitle]: 選擇模擬來電 打上老闆 地區打台灣 按下開始 就會進入來電效果. (5) [Subtitle]: 啊 老闆打電話給我了 掰掰. (6) [Subtitle]: 老闆問我下班要不要去應酬 好不想去喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 用模擬訊息功能好了 打上姓名和內容 還可以選圖示 再截圖起來傳到群組. (8) [Variety]: 計畫通り. (9) [Subtitle]: 等等 大家都一副沒有要去結帳的樣子. (10) [Subtitle]: 他們一定又要用我的行動支付 但跟大家收錢真的超麻煩的耶. (11) [Subtitle]: 趕快拿出逃跑神器 開啟模擬關機功能. (12) [Subtitle]: 我手機沒電了耶 啊我沒有辦法付錢了. (13) [Variety]: 哼哼哼哼. (14) [Subtitle]: 為什麼是我留下來洗碗啊.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, cheerful electronic background music begins with a driving synthesizer beat. A young female voice speaks in Mandarin with a high-pitched, energetic, and slightly exaggerated tone. A bright 'Ding' sound effect plays to signal a realization moment. (2) As the narration describes the app functions, rapid digital clicking sounds simulate typing. A standard iPhone-style ringtone is triggered and plays clearly over the music. The female voice maintains a high speech rate with expressive rising intonations. (3) A 'Whoosh' transition sound occurs as the scene shifts. The speaker adopts a more conspiratorial, whispered tone while describing office social pressure. The music continues without pause, providing a consistent rhythmic foundation for the narration. (4) A digital notification chime sounds, followed by the speaker's triumphant exclamation. A 'Meme' style laugh effect or short comedic sound is interspersed. The audio texture is dense with overlapping speech, BGM, and frequent UI sound effects. (5) A sharp digitized low-battery alert plays, matching the visual of the dead phone. The music swells slightly. The final phase features a dramatic, whiny vocal delivery from the woman, ending with the background sound of running water and metallic clinking.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Scene 1 (Date Escape) -> Scene 2 (Office Overtime Escape) -> Scene 3 (Bill Paying Escape) -> Ironical Twist (Dish Washing).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and demonstrate the features of the 'ESC 逃跑神器' app by showing relatable, awkward social scenarios where a fake call or simulated low-battery screen provides a convenient excuse.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of app icon, interface demonstration, and slogan '逃跑神器'.
